tasks.title: Update learning schema and build update-learning.py
tasks.description: Add 'stale' and 'invalid' to the allowed status enum in learning-schema.json alongside 'captured' and 'applied'. Then build a new update-learning.py script in claude-code-shared/scripts/ that takes --id <uuid> and --status <new_status> arguments, reads unified-learnings.jsonl, finds the entry by UUID, updates its status field, and rewrites the file atomically using fcntl.flock (same locking pattern as log-learning.py). The script should validate the new status against learning-schema.json before writing. Exit 0 on success, exit 1 with stderr on validation or write failure.
acceptance_criteria: learning-schema.json status enum contains: captured, applied, stale, invalid
update-learning.py accepts --id and --status args
update-learning.py validates status value against schema before writing
update-learning.py uses fcntl.flock for atomic file rewrite
update-learning.py exits 0 on success, 1 on error with stderr message
update-learning.py correctly finds entry by UUID and updates only the status field
Manual test: run update-learning.py on a test entry and verify the jsonl file is correctly updated
tasks.summary: Added stale/invalid to learning-schema.json status enum and created update-learning.py with atomic rewrite via fcntl.flock.

tasks.title: Rename improve-skill to improve-skill-benchmarks
tasks.description: Rename the skill directory from claude-code-shared/skills/improve-skill/ to claude-code-shared/skills/improve-skill-benchmarks/. Update all references across the repo: agent type listings in .claude/agents/*.md frontmatter, settings.json skill registrations, any SKILL.md files that reference improve-skill by name, CLAUDE.md files, and any improve-skill-specific scripts or resources. Also update any existing learnings in unified-learnings.jsonl where reported_by or improves fields reference 'improve-skill' to use 'improve-skill-benchmarks'. This is a mechanical rename. Characterize the full set of references before renaming to ensure nothing is missed.

tasks.title: Build improve-skill-learnings SKILL.md and register
tasks.description: Create the new skill at claude-code-shared/skills/improve-skill-learnings/SKILL.md. The skill reads unified-learnings.jsonl, filters to status == captured entries, groups by improves field, shows a ranked table sorted by count with null-improves shown as unassigned, and lets the user pick a target. For the selected target, it spawns Haiku validation agents (one per learning) to check staleness, correctness, and resolve the target file path (searching skills/, agents/, resources/, scripts/). Invalid or stale learnings get marked via update-learning.py. Surviving learnings are passed to a session-model agent that reads all of them plus the current target file and drafts a cohesive unified diff. The diff is presented for user approval. On approval, changes are applied and auto-committed with a descriptive message. A summary report shows acted/stale/invalid counts plus remaining backlog. The skill covers all four improves_type values (skill, agent, process, contract). Include the standard learning-capture block at the end. Register the skill in settings.json and agent type listings.
acceptance_criteria: SKILL.md exists at claude-code-shared/skills/improve-skill-learnings/SKILL.md
Skill reads unified-learnings.jsonl and filters to status == captured
Ranked table displays skills grouped by learning count with unassigned row for null improves
Haiku validation agents spawned per learning for staleness and file resolution
Learnings marked stale or invalid via update-learning.py when validation fails
Session-model agent drafts cohesive diff from validated learnings for the target
Diff presented for user approval before any edits
Auto-commit on approval with descriptive message format: improve(<target>): apply N learnings
Summary report shows acted/stale/invalid counts and remaining backlog
Skill registered in settings.json and agent type listings
Learning-capture block included at end of SKILL.md
tasks.summary: Created improve-skill-learnings SKILL.md with 8-step pipeline. Registered in model-tiers, skill-pipeline, registry, and contracts.
